data.description: SQL编程练习 - UNION联合查询

text:
-- 合并当前订单和历史订单
SELECT order_id, user_id, amount, status, created_at
FROM current_orders
WHERE status = 'active'
UNION
SELECT order_id, user_id, amount, status, created_at
FROM archived_orders
WHERE created_at > '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;

-- UNION ALL 保留重复记录
SELECT product_id, name, 'online' AS source
FROM online_products
UNION ALL
SELECT product_id, name, 'offline' AS source
FROM offline_products;

-- 查询高价值用户（订单总额>10000或订单数>50）
SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, 'high_value' AS type
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id
HAVING SUM(amount) > 10000
UNION
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, 'frequent' AS type
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;
